how: Kept by hand. Each occasion dresses the Hub header between its from and to dates (month and day, Bermuda time) and puts a card on Today. look is lights or line. mark is the code point of the emblem. words pick matching events out of the planner. items are the main dates, checked by hand: d is month and day, match is a word that drops the planner's own copy of the same event, place is an Explore card id. Check every date against its link each year.

occasions.title: Christmas in Bermuda
occasions.intro: The parades, the walkabout and what else is on over Christmas.

items.name: National Trust Christmas Walkabout
items.note: The old town by lamplight. National Trust houses open free for the evening, among them the Old Rectory, Bridge House, Buckingham, Reeve Court and Stewart Hall.

items.name: MarketPlace Christmas Parade
items.note: The Santa Claus parade. Route: out of Par-la-Ville car park, east along Church Street, down Court Street, then west along Front Street to finish at the Birdcage. Last year the route closed to traffic at 2.30pm, so come early. Check the MarketPlace notice nearer the day.

items.name: Christmas Boat Parade
items.note: Lit up boats make about two laps of the harbour. Free family activities on shore, and fireworks.

items.name: Red Cross Jingle Run and Walk
items.note: A 3K fun run or walk and a 5K, in aid of the Bermuda Red Cross. This year's theme is Santa's Workshop: come dressed as Santa, an elf, a reindeer or a Christmas tree. Prizes for the best costumes. Sign up before 6pm on Friday 11 December, when the entry price goes up.

occasions.title: Whale season
occasions.intro: Humpback whales pass Bermuda in March and April on their way north.

items.name: Watch from Portuguese Rock
items.note: The cliff at Spittal Pond is a good place to spot them from land. Take binoculars and keep back from the edge.
